registeredBy: Sam (owner); registered on his instruction to close the predictive econometrics gaps, before any run of this test
hypothesis: An AR on yearly consumer price inflation (lag 0-2 by BIC), fitted at each past IMF WEO edition on the last 15 years that edition marks as actual data, has a lower RMSE than carrying the last actual year on, one and two years ahead, scored against the first edition that marks the target year as actual. Every country the saved editions cover.
knownLimits: A 15-year window keeps old hyperinflations from setting today's coefficients (the reason cpi_forecast v1 failed).
Reads only the WEO editions saved in data/local/weo-vintages/.
The IMF's own projection in the origin edition is reported beside the verdict, not used for it.
